events.factual_description: Rhizome DC and Transparent Productions present Michael Sarian's Esquina with Dave Ballou and the for-tet on Thursday, September 10, 2026. Doors are at 18:30 and music begins at 19:00; the event listing runs through 22:00. Rhizome lists a $20-$30 sliding-scale ticket. Rhizome describes Esquina as using loosely structured compositions and graphic scores with electronics, extended improvisation, and themes connected to Sarian's Armenian heritage and Argentine upbringing. Greenleaf Music's August 28 tour notice confirms the September 10 Rhizome date and says Sarian is debuting new music on this tour. Rhizome identifies Dave Ballou's for-tet as Ballou on trumpet, John Dieker on bass clarinet, Adam Hopkins on bass, and Mike Kuhl on drums; Ballou states that the ensemble performs these compositions without rehearsal or advance discussion of structure, using the pieces as context while creating form in real time. Rhizome's authorized Pools ticket page verifies the Washington, DC address and the $20-$30 sliding-scale ticket, with fees shown separately by the ticketing platform.

en.why_it_matters: The hook is how both bands decide what a piece is while they are playing it. Sarian's Esquina works with graphic scores, electronics and extended trumpet improvisation, folding his Armenian and Argentine background into a Miles-electric lineage without treating that vocabulary as museum repertory. Ballou's for-tet pushes the same question from another angle: the compositions provide context, but the quartet deliberately avoids rehearsal or a pre-agreed structure and builds the form through collective decisions in real time. Putting those two trumpet-led systems in the same Rhizome night gives the bill a clear musical argument rather than just two compatible jazz sets.
en.trip_verdict: If Thursday evening is open in the DMV, this is worth the short trip to Rhizome and an easy night to attend on its own merits. I would not reorganize a larger regional itinerary around it, but the small-room setting and unusually process-driven double bill make it a useful date to keep visible.

es.why_it_matters: El gancho está en cómo las dos bandas deciden qué es la pieza mientras la están tocando. Esquina trabaja con partituras gráficas, electrónica e improvisación extendida de trompeta, incorporando el trasfondo armenio y argentino de Sarian a una línea eléctrica que viene de Miles sin convertirla en repertorio de museo. El for-tet de Ballou plantea la misma pregunta desde otro ángulo: las composiciones dan el contexto, pero el cuarteto evita deliberadamente el ensayo y una estructura acordada de antemano, y construye la forma con decisiones colectivas en tiempo real. Poner esos dos sistemas liderados por trompeta en la misma noche de Rhizome le da al cartel un argumento musical claro y no sólo dos sets compatibles de jazz.
es.trip_verdict: Si el jueves por la noche está libre en el DMV, vale el traslado corto a Rhizome y funciona perfectamente como salida por sí misma. No reorganizaría un itinerario regional más grande alrededor de esta fecha, pero el cuarto pequeño y el doble cartel tan centrado en el proceso hacen que convenga mantenerla visible.
